portal_summary: An update is now available for Red Hat build of Quarkus.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.8.4.SP1 release
portal_product_filter: Red Hat build of Quarkus|Red Hat build of Quarkus|Text-Only Advisories|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
3.8.4.SP1 version of Red Hat build of Quarkus is released along with inclusion of Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.4 for Quarkus 3.8 in the Red Hat build of Quarkus platform.

3.8.4.SP1 release of Red Hat build of Quarkus is otherwise equivalent to 3.8.4.GA release.
